name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement, needs triage

---

Before opening this issue, please read the "What we do not accept" section of CONTRIBUTING.md. Requests for new architectures, dependencies, build steps, or framework rewrites will be closed without discussion.

## The problem

What are you trying to do that the tool cannot do today? Describe the problem, not the solution.

## Your idea

What would the solution look like? Be as specific as you can.

## Alternatives you have considered

What else have you thought about? Why is your idea better?

## Scope

Roughly how much of the codebase would this touch? Which modules would need to change?

- [ ] input.js — input pipelines
- [ ] network.js — network architecture
- [ ] visualize.js — rendering
- [ ] classes.js — class management
- [ ] main.js — wiring, save and load, main loop
- [ ] style.css — styling
- [ ] index.html — markup
- [ ] Documentation only

## Would you be willing to build it?

- [ ] Yes, I can open a pull request
- [ ] Yes, with guidance
- [ ] No, but I would like to see it built

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the "What we do not accept" section of CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] I searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] This feature fits the project's philosophy of no dependencies, no build step, no framework
- [ ] This feature is not on the rejected list of new architectures or backend additions
